Convert a Timestral forecast to a tsibble

Source: R/tsibble.R
as_tsibble.timestral_forecast.Rd

The result is a tsibble over the forecast horizon with one row per series/variate/step and one column per quantile level (as in as_forecast_df()). Registered as an S3 method for tsibble::as_tsibble() when the tsibble package is loaded; call it as tsibble::as_tsibble(fc). The index column keeps the name of the input tsibble's index, and is index otherwise, as tsibble::as_tsibble() names it for ts, zoo and xts. Forecasts from ts input use the same index class (yearmonth, yearquarter, ...) that tsibble::as_tsibble() gives the ts, so they join with the observed data. Forecasts can also be created directly from a tsibble: in timestral_forecast(), tsibble keys become the batch and measured variables the jointly forecast variates.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'timestral_forecast'
as_tsibble(x, ...)

Arguments

x

a timestral_forecast created from indexed input (ts, zoo, xts or tsibble), so a future time index is available

...

ignored

Value

a tsibble (tbl_ts)

Examples

## the tiny bundled checkpoint runs offline but its forecasts are
## meaningless; use timestral_load("5M") or larger for real ones
m <- timestral_load(system.file("extdata", "tiny", package = "timestralR"))
fc <- timestral_forecast(m, AirPassengers, h = 24)
if (requireNamespace("tsibble", quietly = TRUE))
  tsibble::as_tsibble(fc)
